title: Water stains on your ceiling? Common causes in UAE homes and how to fix them
desc: Why ceilings leak in Dubai apartments and villas, how to find the source and how to stop it for good.
intro: A brown or yellow stain on the ceiling is one of the most common problems in UAE homes. Painting over it hides it for a few weeks, but the water keeps coming until you fix the source.
qa: What causes water stains on a ceiling in Dubai?

The most common causes are a failed bathroom floor membrane or leaking drain in the flat above, a blocked or leaking AC drain line, a cracked roof waterproofing membrane on villas and top floors, and condensation from poorly insulated AC ducts. Each needs a different fix, so finding the source comes first.
How do I find where a ceiling leak is coming from?

Check what is directly above the stain: a bathroom, kitchen, AC unit or roof. Note whether it grows after showers, after the AC runs or after rain. A technician confirms the source with a moisture meter before opening the ceiling.
Can I just repaint over a water stain?

No. Paint does not stop water. The stain returns and the gypsum board can sag or grow mould. Fix the leak, let the area dry, replace damaged board, prime with a stain-blocking primer and then repaint.
How is a bathroom leak to the flat below fixed properly?
The tiles are removed, drains and pipe penetrations are sealed, a waterproofing membrane is applied to the floor and lower walls, the floor is flood-tested for 24 hours, then it is retiled.
How long does roof waterproofing last in the UAE?
A correctly installed membrane system typically lasts 10 to 15 years, and exposed reflective coatings around 5 to 10 years, depending on sun exposure and foot traffic.

title: AC maintenance before UAE summer: a simple checklist
desc: What to check and service on your AC before temperatures pass 40°C, and the warning signs it needs a technician.
intro: UAE summers push air conditioning harder than almost anywhere else. A service in spring prevents most breakdowns in July and August and keeps electricity bills lower.
qa: How often should an AC be serviced in Dubai?

Split units in daily use should be serviced every 3 to 4 months, with a full service before summer. Ducts should be cleaned about once a year, or every 6 months if you have allergies, pets or construction nearby.
What are the signs my AC needs a service?

The unit runs non-stop but the room never feels cold, water drips from the indoor unit, there is a musty smell when it switches on, ice forms on the pipes, or your electricity bill rises without more use.
Why is my AC running but not cooling?
Usually low refrigerant gas from a leak, a dirty coil or filter, a blocked condenser outside, or a failed capacitor. A technician checks pressures and cleans the coils to find the cause.
What does an AC service include?
Filter and coil cleaning, drain line flushing, refrigerant pressure check and gas top-up if needed, electrical and thermostat checks, and cleaning of the outdoor unit.
Is duct cleaning necessary?
Yes for ducted and concealed systems. Dust, mould and bacteria build up inside ducts and blow into the room. Cleaning improves air quality and airflow.

title: Gypsum false ceilings: what to plan before you install
desc: Lighting, AC grilles, access panels and board types: what to decide before installing a false ceiling in Dubai.
intro: A gypsum false ceiling hides ducts and wiring and lets you add cove lighting and spotlights. Most problems come from poor planning, so decide these points before any board goes up.
qa: What is a false ceiling?
A second ceiling built below the concrete slab on a galvanised metal frame, finished with gypsum board. It hides AC ducts, pipes and wiring and creates space for lighting.
How much height does a false ceiling take?
Usually 15 to 30 cm, depending on the ducts and lighting above it. Cove lighting troughs need a little more depth at the edges.
What should I plan before installing a false ceiling?
Plan the positions of lights, AC grilles, smoke detectors and speakers, add access panels for AC and plumbing servicing, and choose moisture-resistant board for bathrooms and kitchens.
Is gypsum suitable for bathrooms?
Yes, if you use moisture-resistant board and the bathroom has a working exhaust fan.
How long does a false ceiling take to install?
A typical room takes 2 to 4 days including taping, sanding and painting. A full apartment takes about 1 to 2 weeks.

title: Which paint finish for which room? A guide for Dubai homes
desc: Matt, silk, satin or gloss: choosing the right interior and exterior paint finish for UAE homes.
intro: The right finish makes walls look better and easier to clean. The wrong one shows every mark or peels in humid rooms.
qa: Which paint finish is best for living rooms?
Eggshell or silk. It has a soft sheen, hides small marks and can be wiped clean, which suits living rooms, corridors and children's rooms.
Which paint finish is best for bathrooms and kitchens?
Satin, ideally an anti-mould, moisture-resistant formula. It handles humidity and frequent cleaning.
Which paint finish is best for ceilings?
Matt. It hides surface imperfections and reflects light evenly.
What paint should be used outside in the UAE?
Exterior weathershield paint designed for heat, UV and dust, applied over a crack-repaired and sealed surface.
How long does it take to repaint an apartment?
A 1-bedroom apartment usually takes 1 to 2 days and a 2-bedroom 2 to 3 days, depending on the preparation needed.

title: Wall moulding and panelling ideas for apartments and villas
desc: Classic panels, slim modern frames and wainscoting: how to choose and plan wall moulding for your home.
intro: Wall moulding adds depth, light and shadow to plain walls and gives a room a finished, high-end look without major construction.
qa: What is wall moulding?
Decorative profiles fixed to the wall to create panels or frames, usually painted the same colour as the wall. Common styles are classic French panels, modern slim frames and wainscoting.
Which moulding material is best?
High-density polyurethane (PU) is the most popular in the UAE: light, moisture-resistant and easy to paint. MDF and gypsum are also used.
Does wall moulding suit small rooms?
Yes. Paint the walls and moulding the same light colour and use tall vertical frames to make the ceiling feel higher.
How long does a moulding feature wall take?
Usually 1 to 2 days including filling and painting. A full room takes 2 to 4 days.
Can moulding go on any wall?
Yes, on block, concrete or gypsum walls, as long as the wall is flat. Uneven walls are skimmed first.
